story: When Chai Rong died in 959, his son was a small child, and the commander of the palace army, Zhao Kuangyin, was one of the most powerful men at court. Early in 960 a report arrived, probably false, that Liao and Northern Han were invading. Zhao led the army north out of Kaifeng.

At Chenqiao Station, about twenty kilometres from the capital, his officers, led by his brother Zhao Kuangyi and his secretary Zhao Pu, woke him, put a yellow imperial robe on him and hailed him as emperor. He made the troops promise not to harm the imperial family or loot the city. Back in Kaifeng the boy emperor abdicated, and the Song dynasty was proclaimed, named after Zhao's old post at Songzhou.
story_zh: 959年柴荣去世，儿子还是个幼童，而禁军统帅赵匡胤是朝中最有权势的人物之一。960年初，传来辽和北汉入侵的消息，这很可能是假情报。赵匡胤率军从开封北上。
在离京城约二十公里的陈桥驿，以弟弟赵光义和幕僚赵普为首的部将们叫醒他，把黄袍披在他身上，拥立他为皇帝。赵匡胤要求将士们保证不得伤害后周皇室、不得抢掠京城。回到开封后，小皇帝退位，宋朝建立，国号取自赵匡胤原先担任节度使的宋州。
chenqiao.why: The almost bloodless coup ended the cycle of military takeovers, because Taizu then made sure no general could do the same to him.
chenqiao.why_zh: 这次几乎兵不血刃的政变终结了武人轮番夺权的循环，因为宋太祖随后想方设法确保不再有将领能如法炮制。

story: Emperor Taizong, Zhao Kuangyi, finished his brother's work of reunification: Wuyue submitted peacefully in 978, and in the spring of 979 Song forces took Taiyuan and ended the Northern Han. Without resting his tired army, Taizong marched northeast to seize the Sixteen Prefectures and besieged the Liao Southern Capital at Youzhou (Beijing).

The city held out, and Liao relief armies under Yelü Xiuge and Yelü Xiezhen arrived. In the battle beside the Gaoliang River, west of the city, the Liao cavalry attacked the Song army from two sides and routed it. Taizong was wounded by arrows and escaped, according to a later story, in a donkey cart.
A second great Song invasion, in 986, also failed.
story_zh: 宋太宗赵光义完成了兄长的统一事业：978年吴越和平归附，979年春宋军攻下太原，灭亡北汉。太宗不让疲惫的军队休整，便挥师东北，想夺取燕云十六州，包围了辽朝的南京幽州（今北京）。
幽州城久攻不下，耶律休哥、耶律斜轸率辽朝援军赶到。在城西的高梁河边，辽军骑兵从两翼夹击，宋军大败。太宗身中箭伤，据后来的传说是乘驴车逃走的。
986年宋军再次大举北伐，同样以失败告终。
gaoliang.why: After these defeats the Song gave up trying to take the Sixteen Prefectures by force and turned to defence.
gaoliang.why_zh: 经过这几次失败，宋朝放弃了以武力收复燕云十六州的打算，转为防御。

story: In the autumn of 1004 the Liao Empress Dowager Xiao and Emperor Shengzong led a large army deep into Song territory, bypassing fortified towns and reaching the Yellow River at Chanzhou. Many Song ministers urged Emperor Zhenzong to flee south. The chief minister Kou Zhun persuaded him instead to go to the front.

The emperor's arrival at Chanzhou lifted morale, and a senior Liao commander, Xiao Talin, was killed by a Song crossbow bolt. Neither side wanted a long war. In early 1005 the envoy Cao Liyong agreed a treaty: Song would send Liao 100,000 taels of silver and 200,000 bolts of silk every year, the two emperors would treat each other as brothers, and the border would stay where it was.
story_zh: 1004年秋，辽朝萧太后和辽圣宗率大军深入宋境，绕过坚城，直抵黄河边的澶州。许多宋朝大臣劝宋真宗南逃避难，宰相寇准却力劝他亲临前线。
真宗驾临澶州，宋军士气大振，辽军大将萧挞览又被宋军的床弩射死。双方都不愿久战。1005年初，使臣曹利用与辽方达成和约：宋朝每年给辽银十万两、绢二十万匹，两国皇帝以兄弟相称，边界维持原状。
chanyuan.why: The payments were small next to the cost of war, and the treaty brought more than a century of peace and trade between Song and Liao.
chanyuan.why_zh: 与战争的耗费相比，这笔岁币并不算多；和约带来了宋辽之间一百多年的和平与贸易。

story: The Tanguts, a people living in the Ordos and the Gansu corridor, had been ruled by their own chiefs as Song and Liao vassals. Li Yuanhao, who succeeded his father in 1032, wanted full independence. He ordered his people to shave their heads in Tangut style, set up a Chinese-style government and had a Tangut script created, introduced in 1036.

In 1038 he declared himself emperor of Great Xia, with his capital at Xingqing, modern Yinchuan. Chinese sources call the state Western Xia. The Song refused to recognise him, and war broke out. Xia won three major battles between 1040 and 1042, at Sanchuankou, Haoshuichuan and Dingchuan, and peace was made in 1044.
story_zh: 党项人居住在河套和河西走廊一带，原先由本族首领统治，名义上向宋、辽称臣。1032年继位的李元昊决心完全独立。他下令部众按党项习俗剃发，仿照中原建立官制，又命人创制西夏文字，于1036年颁行。
1038年，他称帝建国，国号大夏，定都兴庆府（今银川），史称西夏。宋朝拒不承认，双方爆发战争。1040年至1042年间，西夏在三川口、好水川、定川寨连胜三次大战，1044年双方议和。
xixia.why: Western Xia controlled the Silk Road between China and Central Asia for nearly two centuries, until the Mongols destroyed it in 1227.
xixia.why_zh: 此后近两百年间，西夏控制着中国与中亚之间的丝绸之路，直到1227年被蒙古所灭。

story: Almost everything known about Bi Sheng comes from a short passage in Shen Kuo's Dream Pool Essays. Shen says that in the Qingli era (1041 to 1048) a commoner named Bi Sheng invented a new way of printing. He carved single characters on pieces of sticky clay, each as thin as the edge of a coin, and baked them hard.

To print, he coated an iron plate with a mixture of pine resin, wax and paper ash, set the type inside an iron frame, and warmed the plate so the mixture softened. Pressing the type flat with a board gave an even surface. With two plates, one could be printed while the next was being set. Bi Sheng tried wooden type but rejected it because wood swelled when wet.
After his death his type was kept by Shen Kuo's relatives.
story_zh: 关于毕昇，我们知道的几乎全部来自沈括《梦溪笔谈》中的一小段记载。沈括说，庆历年间（1041年至1048年），一位名叫毕昇的平民发明了新的印刷方法：他用胶泥刻字，每字一印，薄如钱唇，再用火烧硬。
印刷时，先在铁板上敷一层松脂、蜡和纸灰的混合物，把活字排进铁框里，再把铁板放到火上烘烤，使混合物熔化，用平板一压，字面便平整如砥。准备两块铁板，一块印刷时，另一块就可以排字。毕昇也试过木活字，但因木头遇水会膨胀变形而放弃。
毕昇死后，他的活字被沈括的族人收藏。
movable-type.why: It is the earliest known movable type in the world, about four centuries before Gutenberg, though woodblocks remained more common in China.
movable-type.why_zh: 这是世界上已知最早的活字印刷，比古腾堡早了约四百年；不过在中国，雕版印刷仍然更为普遍。

quote.zh: 庆历中，有布衣毕昇，又为活板。
quote.en: In the Qingli years, a commoner named Bi Sheng also made movable type.
quote.from: Shen Kuo, Dream Pool Essays 沈括《梦溪笔谈》

story: When the young Emperor Shenzong came to the throne in 1067, the state was short of money and its armies had done poorly against Western Xia. In 1069 he made Wang Anshi, a brilliant and stubborn official, his chief adviser on reform.

Over the next few years Wang introduced the New Policies. The Green Sprouts law gave farmers state loans in spring to be repaid at harvest. Hired service replaced unpaid local labour duties with a cash tax. The baojia system organised households into groups for policing and militia training. Other laws managed markets, transport and land surveys.
Opponents such as Sima Guang, Su Shi and Ouyang Xiu said the laws hurt the people and enriched the state. Wang left office in 1076, but Shenzong kept the reforms until his death in 1085.
story_zh: 1067年，年轻的宋神宗即位。当时国库空虚，对西夏作战又屡屡失利。1069年，他任用才华出众而又性格执拗的王安石主持变法。
此后几年间，王安石陆续推出新法：青苗法在春天由官府向农民放贷，秋收后归还；免役法以交钱代替无偿承担的地方差役；保甲法把民户编组起来，负责治安并接受军事训练；还有关于市场、运输和清丈田亩等方面的法令。
司马光、苏轼、欧阳修等反对者认为，新法与民争利、扰民害民。王安石于1076年罢相，但神宗直到1085年去世前一直坚持推行新法。
wang-anshi.why: The reforms split the scholar-officials into bitter factions that fought each other until the end of the Northern Song.
wang-anshi.why_zh: 变法使士大夫分裂成势不两立的派系，党争一直持续到北宋灭亡。

quote.zh: 天变不足畏，祖宗不足法，人言不足恤。
quote.en: Changes in the heavens need not be feared; the ancestors need not be followed; what people say need not be heeded.
quote.from: Words attributed to Wang Anshi in the History of Song 《宋史·王安石传》

story: In 1066 the scholar-official Sima Guang presented the first part of a chronological history to Emperor Yingzong, who gave him a team of scholars and access to the imperial library. The next emperor, Shenzong, gave the work its name, which means 'Comprehensive Mirror to Aid in Government'.

Sima Guang opposed Wang Anshi's reforms and in 1071 withdrew to Luoyang, where he worked on the history for fifteen years with his assistants Liu Ban, Liu Shu and Fan Zuyu. They compared many earlier sources and noted where they disagreed. The finished work, in 294 chapters, covers 1,362 years, from 403 BCE to the end of the Later Zhou in 959. It was presented in 1084.
story_zh: 1066年，司马光向宋英宗进呈了一部编年史的初稿。英宗准许他组建编书机构，并可借阅皇家藏书。继位的宋神宗为这部书赐名《资治通鉴》，意思是“有助于治国的通贯古今的镜子”。
司马光反对王安石变法，1071年退居洛阳，此后与助手刘攽、刘恕、范祖禹一起编书长达十五年。他们比对大量前代史料，并注明各书记载不同之处。全书二百九十四卷，记载了从公元前403年到959年后周灭亡共一千三百六十二年的历史，于1084年进呈朝廷。
zizhi-tongjian.why: It became the most widely read history in China after the Records of the Grand Historian, studied by rulers and officials for nine centuries.
zizhi-tongjian.why_zh: 它成为继《史记》之后流传最广的中国史书，九百多年来一直是帝王和官员研读的典籍。

quote.en: It mirrors past events and so aids the way of government.
quote.from: Emperor Shenzong, naming the work 宋神宗赐名语

story: The Jurchen were forest and river peoples of Manchuria, ruled by the Liao and made to send tribute such as gyrfalcons, pearls and furs. Liao envoys were known for their arrogance. In 1112, at a feast held by the Liao emperor Tianzuo, the Jurchen chief Wanyan Aguda refused the emperor's order to dance.

In 1114 Aguda rose in revolt and beat a Liao army at Ningjiang. Early in 1115 he declared himself emperor of Great Jin, meaning 'gold', at Huining, near modern Harbin. Later that year Tianzuo led a huge army against him and was badly defeated.
The Jin then took the Liao capitals one after another. Aguda died in 1123, and his brother finished the conquest of Liao in 1125.
story_zh: 女真人生活在东北的森林和河流地带，受辽朝统治，要向辽进贡海东青、北珠和毛皮，辽朝使者对他们十分骄横。1112年，在辽天祚帝举行的宴会上，女真首领完颜阿骨打拒绝奉命起舞。
1114年，阿骨打起兵反辽，在宁江州大败辽军。1115年初，他在会宁（今哈尔滨附近）称帝，国号大金。同年，天祚帝亲率大军征讨，结果惨败。
此后金朝接连攻下辽朝各京城。阿骨打于1123年去世，他的弟弟在1125年灭亡了辽朝。
jurchen-jin.why: The rise of Jin destroyed the Liao and, within two years more, the Northern Song as well.
jurchen-jin.why_zh: 金朝的崛起灭亡了辽朝，两年之后又灭亡了北宋。

story: Emperor Taizu knew that he had seized the throne because his troops wanted it, and that any of his generals might do the same. According to Song accounts, in the autumn of 961 he invited his leading commanders, including Shi Shouxin, to a banquet. When everyone had drunk well, he told them he could not sleep at night, because if their own men ever put a yellow robe on them, they would have no choice.
The next day the generals asked to retire. Taizu gave them rich estates and honours, and marriages linked their families to his. Command of the palace army was split among lower-ranking officers.
Historians debate whether the banquet happened as told, since it appears only in later accounts, but the policy itself is clear. Civil officials controlled the military, and generals were rotated.
story_zh: 宋太祖深知，自己能当上皇帝是因为部下想要拥立他，而他手下的任何一个将领都可能如法炮制。据宋人记载，961年秋，他邀请石守信等主要将领赴宴。酒酣之时，他对众人说自己夜里睡不着觉，因为万一哪天他们的部下也把黄袍披到他们身上，他们就身不由己了。
第二天，将领们纷纷请求解除兵权。太祖赏给他们丰厚的田宅和爵位，还与他们结为姻亲。禁军的指挥权则分给几位资历较浅的将领。
这场宴会是否真如记载那样发生过，史学家仍有争论，因为它只见于后世的记载；但这项政策本身是确定的：以文官驾驭武将，统兵将领定期调动。
cup-of-wine.why: It ended two centuries of military coups, but critics have long blamed the policy for the Song's military weakness.
cup-of-wine.why_zh: 这一政策终结了两百年来武人篡权的局面，但历来也有人认为宋朝军力孱弱正是由此造成的。

story: After Later Zhou took its lands north of the Yangtze, the Southern Tang paid tribute to Kaifeng and its ruler Li Yu, a gifted poet, tried to avoid giving offence. Song conquered Jingnan, Later Shu and Southern Han one by one. In 974 Taizu summoned Li Yu to court, and when he pleaded illness, Song attacked.

The general Cao Bin led the campaign. Following a plan by Fan Ruoshui, a Southern Tang scholar who had gone over to Song, the army built a pontoon bridge of boats across the Yangtze at Caishi and crossed in force. Jinling was besieged for most of 975, and fell at the end of the year. Cao Bin forbade his troops to massacre the inhabitants.
Li Yu surrendered and was taken to Kaifeng, where he died in 978.
story_zh: 后周夺取江北之后，南唐向开封称臣纳贡。南唐后主李煜是一位才华横溢的词人，处处小心不敢得罪宋朝。宋朝相继灭了荆南、后蜀和南汉。974年，宋太祖召李煜入朝，李煜称病不去，宋军随即南征。
大将曹彬统率宋军。宋军采用投奔宋朝的南唐文人樊若水的计策，在采石矶用船只在长江上搭起浮桥，大军顺利渡江。975年金陵被围困了大半年，年底城破。曹彬严令不得屠城。
李煜出降，被押往开封，978年死在那里。
southern-tang-conquered.why: The fall of the largest southern state made Song reunification all but certain; Li Yu's lyrics of loss became some of the most loved in Chinese.
southern-tang-conquered.why_zh: 南方最大的国家灭亡后，宋朝统一已成定局；李煜亡国后写下的词，成为中国人最喜爱的作品之一。

quote.zh: 卧榻之侧，岂容他人鼾睡乎！
quote.en: How can I let another man snore beside my bed?
quote.from: Emperor Taizu, recorded in the Xu Zizhi Tongjian Changbian 宋太祖语，见《续资治通鉴长编》

story: Champa, a kingdom in what is now central Vietnam, grew a rice that ripened quickly and needed less water than Chinese varieties. Farmers in Fujian had already begun planting it. In 1011 and 1012 drought struck the lands along the Yangtze and Huai.

Emperor Zhenzong ordered officials to obtain 30,000 bushels of Champa rice seed from Fujian and distribute it in the Jiangnan, Huainan and Liangzhe regions, along with instructions for growing it. Because it ripened in about a hundred days, it could be planted on higher, drier land, and in warm areas it allowed farmers to grow two crops a year.
Over the following decades the new rice spread across southern China.
story_zh: 占城是位于今越南中部的一个王国，那里出产一种稻米，生长期短，需水量比中国原有品种少。福建农民已经开始种植。1011年和1012年，长江、淮河流域接连遭遇旱灾。
宋真宗下令从福建调取占城稻种三万斛，分发到江南、淮南和两浙地区，并附上种植方法。由于占城稻约一百天就能成熟，可以种在地势较高、较干旱的田里；在温暖地区，农民还能一年种两季。
此后几十年间，这种新稻种遍及中国南方。
champa-rice.why: More rice fed a fast-growing population, which rose to over 100 million in the Song, and shifted China's economic centre firmly to the south.
champa-rice.why_zh: 粮食增产养活了快速增长的人口，宋代人口突破一亿，中国的经济重心也彻底移到了南方。

story: Sichuan used heavy iron coins, so a large purchase meant carrying a great weight of metal. Around the year 1000, merchants in Chengdu began issuing paper certificates, called jiaozi, that could be exchanged for coins. Sixteen wealthy houses later received official permission to issue them.

Some issuers printed more notes than they could redeem, and disputes and lawsuits followed. Local officials, including the prefect Xue Tian, proposed that the state take over. In 1023 the government set up a Jiaozi Office in Chengdu, and its first notes were issued in 1024. They were printed from blocks in several colours, valid for a fixed term, and backed by a reserve of cash.
The government later issued paper money in other regions.
story_zh: 四川通行沉重的铁钱，买一样贵重的东西就得扛上一大堆钱。约在公元1000年前后，成都的商人开始发行一种可以兑换铜铁钱的纸质凭证，叫作“交子”。后来有十六家富商获得官府许可，联合发行交子。
有的商户发行的交子超出了兑付能力，引起纠纷和诉讼。益州知州薛田等地方官建议改由官府发行。1023年，朝廷在成都设立交子务，1024年发行第一批官交子。官交子用多色雕版印制，规定有效期限，并以现钱作为准备金。
后来，宋朝在其他地区也发行了纸币。
jiaozi.why: The jiaozi was the world's first government-issued paper money, centuries before paper currency appeared in Europe.
jiaozi.why_zh: 交子是世界上最早由政府发行的纸币，比欧洲出现纸币早了几个世纪。

story: The war with Western Xia exposed how costly and inefficient the Song government had become. There were too many officials, many of them sons of officials who had received posts without examinations. In 1043 Emperor Renzong brought in reformers: Fan Zhongyan, Han Qi and Fu Bi.

Fan sent the emperor a ten-point plan. It called for promotion by merit rather than seniority, fewer posts granted as family privileges, better local officials, exams that tested practical policy, and stronger farming and defence. Renzong approved most of it.

Officials who lost privileges attacked the reformers as a faction. Ouyang Xiu replied with his essay On Factions, but by 1045 Fan and his allies had been sent out of the capital and most reforms were dropped.
story_zh: 与西夏的战争暴露出宋朝政府的开支巨大、效率低下。官员太多，其中不少是凭父祖荫庇、未经考试就当上官的。1043年，宋仁宗起用范仲淹、韩琦、富弼等人推行改革。
范仲淹向仁宗呈上十条建议：按政绩而不是资历升迁，减少凭门荫授官，选好地方官员，科举要考实用的治国之策，并加强农业和边防。仁宗大部分予以采纳。
利益受损的官员攻击改革者结成朋党。欧阳修写了《朋党论》予以回击，但到1045年，范仲淹等人都被调离京城，大部分新政随之废止。
qingli-reforms.why: The failure left the problems unsolved and set the stage for Wang Anshi's more radical reforms twenty-five years later.
qingli-reforms.why_zh: 改革的失败使问题悬而未决，为二十多年后王安石更激进的变法埋下伏笔。

story: During the war with Western Xia, Emperor Renzong ordered a complete handbook of military knowledge. The scholar-officials Zeng Gongliang and Ding Du led the compilation and finished it in 1044. It covers strategy, organisation, fortifications, weapons and the geography of the frontiers, with many illustrations.

The book contains the earliest known written recipes for gunpowder, three in all, mixing saltpetre, sulphur and charcoal with other ingredients. They were for incendiary arrows, fire balls hurled by catapults and smoke bombs.

It also describes a 'south-pointing fish': a thin iron leaf heated and cooled in a north-south line so that it became magnetised, then floated in a bowl of water to show direction. Another section shows a flamethrower using a double-acting pump.
story_zh: 在与西夏作战期间，宋仁宗下令编纂一部全面的军事百科。曾公亮、丁度主持编写，于1044年完成。书中涵盖兵法、军制、城防、兵器和边疆地理，并配有大量插图。
书中载有已知最早的火药配方，共三种，以硝石、硫磺、木炭为主，再配以其他成分，分别用于火箭、抛石机发射的火球和毒烟球。
书中还描述了“指南鱼”：把薄铁片烧红后沿南北方向放置冷却，使其磁化，再放在水碗中浮起，就能指示方向。另有一节绘出了一种使用双向活塞泵的喷火器“猛火油柜”。
wujing-zongyao.why: It documents the early military use of gunpowder and magnetism, two Chinese inventions that would change the world.
wujing-zongyao.why_zh: 它记录了火药和磁性早期的军事应用，这两项中国发明后来改变了世界。

story: Su Shi was already one of the most famous writers in China, and a critic of Wang Anshi's New Policies. In 1079, soon after he became prefect of Huzhou, censors including Li Ding accused him of mocking the emperor and the reforms in his poems and letters.

He was arrested and taken in chains to the Censorate in Kaifeng, nicknamed the Crow Terrace after the crows nesting in its trees. For more than four months he was interrogated about the hidden meanings of his verses, and he expected to be executed. Friends, his brother Su Zhe and, by some accounts, the Grand Empress Dowager and even the retired Wang Anshi spoke up for him.
Emperor Shenzong spared his life and exiled him to Huangzhou on the Yangtze.
story_zh: 苏轼当时已是全国最著名的文学家之一，也是王安石新法的批评者。1079年，他刚到湖州任知州不久，李定等御史就弹劾他在诗文和书信中讥讽皇帝、诽谤新法。
苏轼被逮捕，押解到开封的御史台受审。御史台院中柏树上常有乌鸦栖息，因此又称“乌台”。他被关押了四个多月，反复追问诗句中的“隐含之意”，自以为必死无疑。朋友们、弟弟苏辙，据说还有太皇太后，甚至已经退居的王安石都为他求情。
宋神宗最终免他一死，把他贬到长江边的黄州。
crow-terrace-case.why: In exile Su Shi took the name Dongpo and wrote some of his greatest works, including the Red Cliff poems; the case became a symbol of political persecution of writers.
crow-terrace-case.why_zh: 苏轼在黄州自号“东坡居士”，写出了《赤壁赋》等不朽名篇；这一案件也成为文字狱的代名词。

story: Emperor Shenzong died in 1085, and his son Zhezong came to the throne aged nine. Real power passed to his grandmother, Grand Empress Dowager Gao, who had always disliked the New Policies. She recalled Sima Guang from Luoyang, and in 1086, the first year of the Yuanyou era, he became chief minister.

Though old and ill, Sima Guang moved fast. He abolished the hired service system, the Green Sprouts loans and other laws, and brought back opponents of reform such as Su Shi. Even some of his allies, including Su Shi, thought he went too far in scrapping useful measures. Wang Anshi died that spring, and Sima Guang that autumn.
When Zhezong took power himself in 1093, he brought the reformers back and punished the Yuanyou ministers.
story_zh: 1085年宋神宗去世，九岁的儿子宋哲宗即位，实权落到一向反对新法的祖母高太皇太后手中。她把司马光从洛阳召回，1086年（元祐元年）任命他为宰相。
司马光虽然年迈多病，却雷厉风行，废除了免役法、青苗法等新法，起用苏轼等反对变法的人。就连苏轼等同道也认为他把有用的措施一概废除，未免过头。这年春天王安石去世，秋天司马光也去世了。
1093年哲宗亲政后，重新起用变法派，打击元祐大臣。
yuanyou-restoration.why: The swings between reform and reaction turned policy debate into a feud that weakened the Song court in its last decades.
yuanyou-restoration.why_zh: 新法与旧法的反复更替，使政策之争演变为派系仇怨，削弱了北宋最后几十年的朝政。

story: Shen Kuo was an official who had served as astronomer, finance commissioner, diplomat and frontier general. After a Song defeat by Western Xia in 1082 he was blamed and dismissed. He retired to an estate he called Dream Brook, at Runzhou on the Yangtze, and there, in the late 1080s, wrote down what he had learned.

The Dream Pool Essays contain more than 600 entries. Shen gives the first clear description of a magnetic needle compass and notes that it points slightly east of south, recognising magnetic declination. He records Bi Sheng's movable type, explains fossils of sea creatures in mountains as evidence that land had once been under the sea, and names the oil of the northwest 'rock oil', shiyou, the word still used today.
story_zh: 沈括担任过天文官、三司使、外交使节和边防将领。1082年宋军在永乐城被西夏打败，他受到牵连被罢官，退居润州长江边一处名为“梦溪”的园子。1080年代后期，他在那里把自己的见闻和研究写成了书。
《梦溪笔谈》共有六百多条。书中首次清楚地描述了磁针指南，并指出磁针“常微偏东，不全南也”，即发现了磁偏角。书中记载了毕昇的活字印刷，用高山中的海洋生物化石推断那里曾是海底，还把西北出产的油料命名为“石油”，这个词沿用至今。
dream-pool-essays.why: The book is one of the richest records of Song science and technology and contains the world's earliest known account of magnetic declination.
dream-pool-essays.why_zh: 这部书是宋代科学技术最丰富的记录之一，其中有世界上已知最早的关于磁偏角的记载。

quote.zh: 方家以磁石磨针锋，则能指南，然常微偏东，不全南也。
quote.en: Diviners rub the point of a needle with a lodestone, and it then points south, but it always inclines slightly to the east and does not point due south.
quote.from: Shen Kuo, Dream Pool Essays 沈括《梦溪笔谈》

story: Almost nothing is known about Zhang Zeduan except a short note written on the scroll by a Jin dynasty scholar: he came from Shandong, studied in Kaifeng and specialised in painting buildings, boats, carts and bridges. He is believed to have worked at the court of Emperor Huizong, early in the twelfth century; the exact date is unknown.

The scroll, about five metres long and only 25 centimetres high, is meant to be unrolled from right to left. It begins in quiet countryside, follows the busy river with its grain boats, reaches the crowded Rainbow Bridge, where a large boat is struggling to lower its mast, and ends at the city gate and the streets inside. Hundreds of people appear: porters, traders, monks, scholars, storytellers and doctors.
story_zh: 关于张择端，我们几乎一无所知，只有金代一位文人在画卷上题写的一段简短跋文：他是山东人，曾在开封游学，擅长画楼阁、舟船、车马和桥梁。人们认为他在十二世纪初宋徽宗的宫廷中作画，确切年份已不可考。
这幅长卷长约五米，高仅二十五厘米左右，要从右向左展开观看。画面从宁静的郊野开始，沿着繁忙的汴河和河上的运粮船向前，来到人群熙攘的虹桥，一艘大船正手忙脚乱地放倒桅杆准备过桥，最后来到城门和城内街市。画中有数百人：挑夫、商贩、僧人、读书人、说书人和郎中。
qingming-scroll.why: It is the most famous Chinese painting and a unique visual record of city life in the Song, the most urban society in the world at the time.
qingming-scroll.why_zh: 这是中国最著名的画作，生动记录了宋代的城市生活，而宋朝是当时世界上城市化程度最高的社会。

people.name: Emperor Huizong of Song
people.role: Emperor of the court where he worked

story: Emperor Huizong was a great painter and collector, and he wanted rare plants and strangely shaped rocks for his gardens in Kaifeng. The official Zhu Mian ran the 'Flower and Rock Network' from Suzhou, seizing such objects from private homes and shipping them north, often at ruinous cost to local people.

In late 1120 Fang La, who owned a lacquer-tree plantation in Qingxi county, in the hills of western Zhejiang, rose in revolt. Tens of thousands joined him. Within weeks the rebels had taken Hangzhou and much of Zhejiang and southern Anhui, killing many officials.
The court sent Tong Guan with an army that had been gathered for the war against Liao. Fang La was captured in 1121 and executed in Kaifeng.
story_zh: 宋徽宗是一位杰出的画家和收藏家，他要为开封的园林搜罗奇花异石。官员朱勔在苏州主持“花石纲”，从百姓家中强取这类东西运往北方，常常让当地人倾家荡产。
1120年底，在浙西山区的青溪县拥有漆园的方腊起兵造反，响应者数以万计。几周之内，起义军就攻下了杭州以及浙江、皖南的大片地区，杀死了许多官员。
朝廷派童贯率领原本准备攻辽的大军南下镇压。1121年方腊被俘，押到开封处死。
fang-la.why: The rising weakened the Song just as it was entering its fatal alliance against Liao, and delayed and drained the Song army that attacked Yanjing.
fang-la.why_zh: 这次起义正好发生在宋朝与金结盟攻辽之际，削弱了宋朝国力，也拖延和消耗了北伐燕京的宋军。

people.name: Zhu Mian
people.role: Official in charge of the Flower and Rock Network

story: When the Jurchen began defeating the Liao, Emperor Huizong and his favourite commander, the eunuch Tong Guan, saw a chance to win back the Sixteen Prefectures. Because the Liao lay between them, Song envoys such as Ma Zheng sailed from Dengzhou in Shandong across the Bohai Sea to reach the Jurchen, starting in 1118.

In 1120 the two sides agreed to attack the Liao together. The Jin would take the Liao Central Capital, and the Song would take the Southern Capital at Yanjing (Beijing). Once the Liao fell, the Song would pay the Jin the annual silver and silk it had paid the Liao.
The Song attacks on Yanjing in 1122 failed, and the Jin took the city instead. They handed it over in 1123 only after stripping it of people and wealth, and in return for extra payments.
story_zh: 女真接连打败辽朝之后，宋徽宗和他宠信的宦官统帅童贯认为收复燕云十六州的机会来了。由于辽朝横亘在中间，从1118年起，马政等宋朝使者从山东登州出发，渡过渤海去联络女真。
1120年，双方约定共同攻辽：金攻辽中京，宋攻辽南京燕京（今北京）；灭辽之后，宋朝把原先给辽的岁币转给金朝。
1122年宋军两次进攻燕京都失败了，最后由金军攻下。1123年金朝才把燕京交给宋朝，交接前已把人口和财物掳掠一空，宋朝还要额外支付钱财。
alliance-at-sea.why: The alliance destroyed the buffer state of Liao and showed the Jin how weak the Song army was, leading straight to the Jin invasion of 1125.
alliance-at-sea.why_zh: 这一盟约消灭了作为缓冲的辽朝，也让金朝看清了宋军的虚弱，直接导致了1125年金军南侵。

story: In early 1041 Li Yuanhao invaded the Song frontier in what is now southern Ningxia. The Song commander in the region, Han Qi, sent the general Ren Fu with a strong force to strike the Xia army from behind, warning him not to be drawn into battle on bad ground.

Ren Fu chased what he thought was a retreating Xia force along the Haoshui River valley. According to the Song accounts, his troops found boxes left on the road; when they opened them, tame pigeons flew out, signalling their position to the hidden Xia army. Xia cavalry attacked from the hills on all sides. Ren Fu refused to surrender and was killed, along with most of his officers and more than ten thousand men.
story_zh: 1041年初，李元昊进犯宋朝在今宁夏南部的边境。负责这一地区的宋朝统帅韩琦派大将任福率精兵绕到夏军背后出击，并告诫他不要在不利地形上贸然交战。
任福追击看似撤退的夏军，进入好水川河谷。据宋人记载，宋军在路边发现几个泥盒，打开后鸽子飞出，向埋伏的夏军报告了宋军位置。夏军骑兵从四面山上杀出。任福拒绝投降，力战而死，同死的还有大部分将领和一万多名士兵。
haoshuichuan.why: It was one of three heavy Song defeats in the war that forced Song to make peace with Western Xia.
haoshuichuan.why_zh: 这是宋夏战争中宋军的三次惨败之一，迫使宋朝最终与西夏议和。

story: Although Western Xia won the major battles of 1040 to 1042, the war hurt it badly. Trade with China stopped, its people ran short of tea, silk and grain, and it also faced conflict with the Liao. The Song, for its part, was paying for huge armies on the northwest frontier.

After long negotiations, peace was agreed in 1044. Li Yuanhao accepted the title of 'lord of the Xia state' and called himself a vassal of the Song emperor rather than an equal. In return, Song agreed to send each year what it called gifts: silver, silk and tea worth about 255,000 units in all. Border markets were reopened for trade.
story_zh: 西夏虽然在1040年至1042年间的几次大战中获胜，自身也损失惨重：与中原的贸易中断，百姓缺少茶叶、丝绸和粮食，同时还与辽朝发生冲突。宋朝则要在西北边境供养庞大的军队。
经过长时间谈判，双方于1044年议和。李元昊接受“夏国主”的封号，向宋称臣，不再与宋帝平起平坐。作为回报，宋朝每年“赐”给西夏银、绢、茶，合计约二十五万五千。边境的榷场也重新开放。
qingli-peace.why: The settlement, like Chanyuan, bought peace with payments and kept the northwest quiet for about two decades.
qingli-peace.why_zh: 这次和议与澶渊之盟一样，以钱物换和平，使西北边境安定了约二十年。

story: Su Song was a senior official and a scholar of astronomy and medicine. In 1086 the court ordered him to build a new astronomical instrument. With the mathematician and engineer Han Gonglian he built a wooden model first, and the full tower was completed in Kaifeng in about 1088.

The tower was about 12 metres tall. A large water wheel turned in steps, controlled by an escapement mechanism that let it move only when each bucket filled. Through gears and a long chain drive, it turned a bronze armillary sphere on the roof, a celestial globe inside, and a five-storey pagoda of figures that rang bells, beat drums and showed placards to mark the hours.
Su Song described the machine with detailed drawings in a book completed in the 1090s.
story_zh: 苏颂是朝廷重臣，也是精通天文和医药的学者。1086年，朝廷命他制造新的天文仪器。他与数学家、工程师韩公廉合作，先做了木制模型，约1088年在开封建成了水运仪象台。
仪象台高约12米。一个大水轮靠擒纵机构控制，每个水斗注满后才转动一格。水轮通过齿轮和长长的链条传动，带动台顶的铜制浑仪、台内的浑象，以及一座五层木阁中的报时木人，木人按时摇铃、击鼓、出示时辰牌。
苏颂后来在1090年代完成的《新仪象法要》一书中，用详细的图样记录了这台机器。
su-song-clock.why: Its escapement and chain drive are among the earliest known, and the tower is often called the world's first astronomical clock.
su-song-clock.why_zh: 它的擒纵机构和链传动是已知最早的同类装置之一，常被称为世界上第一座天文钟。

story: After the Jin took the Liao Supreme Capital in 1120 and the Central Capital in 1122, Emperor Tianzuo fled west into the mountains of Inner Mongolia. In his absence, nobles at Yanjing made another member of the clan emperor, but that regime soon collapsed as well.

Tianzuo spent the next few years on the run with a shrinking band of followers, making failed attempts to fight back. Early in 1125 he was captured by Jin troops under the general Wanyan Loushi near Yingzhou, in northern Shanxi. He was taken to the Jin court and given the title Prince of Haibin, and died in captivity.
One Liao noble, Yelü Dashi, had already led a group west, where he founded the Western Liao in Central Asia.
story_zh: 1120年金军攻下辽上京，1122年又攻下中京，辽天祚帝向西逃入今内蒙古的山区。燕京的贵族趁他不在，另立宗室为帝，但这个政权不久也垮了。
此后几年，天祚帝带着越来越少的随从四处流亡，几次试图反攻都失败了。1125年初，他在山西北部的应州附近被金将完颜娄室俘获，押送到金朝，被封为海滨王，最终死于囚禁之中。
辽朝贵族耶律大石此前已率部西迁，后来在中亚建立了西辽。
liao-falls.why: The end of the Liao removed the buffer between Song and Jin; the Jin invaded Song that same year.
liao-falls.why_zh: 辽朝的灭亡使宋金之间再无缓冲，金军当年就南下攻宋。

story: In late 1125 two Jin armies invaded Song, one under Wanyan Zonghan toward Taiyuan and one under Wanyan Zongwang toward Kaifeng. The Song frontier defences collapsed. Emperor Huizong, terrified, abdicated in favour of his son, Emperor Qinzong, and fled south.

Early in 1126 Zongwang's army reached Kaifeng. The official Li Gang persuaded Qinzong to stay and organised the defence of the walls. The Jin attacks failed, but the court was eager to make peace. It agreed to pay an enormous ransom in gold, silver and silk, to send a prince as hostage and to give up three frontier prefectures, Taiyuan, Zhongshan and Hejian. The Jin withdrew.
The Song then dismissed Li Gang and refused to hand over the prefectures. The Jin returned that autumn.
story_zh: 1125年底，金朝兵分两路攻宋：完颜宗翰攻太原，完颜宗望直扑开封。宋朝边防全线崩溃。惊慌失措的宋徽宗让位给儿子宋钦宗，自己逃往南方。
1126年初，宗望大军兵临开封。官员李纲力劝钦宗留守，并组织军民守城。金军攻城失败，但朝廷急于求和，答应交纳巨额金银绢帛，派亲王作人质，并割让太原、中山、河间三镇。金军随即撤退。
此后宋朝罢免了李纲，又拒不交割三镇。这年秋天，金军卷土重来。
first-siege-kaifeng.why: The Song's failure to use the respite to prepare led directly to the second siege and the fall of Kaifeng in the Jingkang Incident.
first-siege-kaifeng.why_zh: 宋朝没有利用这段喘息之机做好准备，直接导致了金军第二次围城和开封失陷的靖康之变。
